entries_new.name: Village of Aniak
entries_new.recognition: United States federal government, as a tribe with self-government inside US law (not as an independent state)
entries_new.story:
Village of Aniak is a federally recognised Alaska Native tribe listed for Aniak, Alaska.
Federal recognition means the US government deals with the tribe as a government holding certain inherent rights of self-government inside US law.
It is separate from any city government there and from the Alaska Native corporations created in 1971. The list gives no further detail.
